I like to start saying that about 20 years ago I chose Shure and I kept choosing earbuds from this company and I still do and most likely I will in the future.
Then I like to apologize from my english writing and the long story.
Here it goes: I started then with whichever was the $100 selling shure model they sold (big step based on the budget back then for me), then moved to the next and next step up as my income and my passion for music and my age increased, until few years ago for my 50th, I arrived to the 535 which made me very very happy to own them and I still do ($100 per decade I rationalized it....) then several cable in various lengths, earbuds tips etc etc.
Currently I still use to the 315 when I'm on a tablet streaming movies and when I'm on a plane and the 535 when I'm listening to uncompressed music from my Ibasso dx90.
Recently a friend let me borrow the 846 and... whooooo,,,, dangerous ground, they sound just like having 2 speaker embedded in your head, but $$$$$$$$ too much for my budget, they stay in the dream section.
I would suggest shure product to anybody that I speak about music (infact mt friend purchased the 846 based on my suggestion for whatever is worth), not only for their product but as well for their tech customer service and the two years warranty.
To sum it, I'm an happy shure customer.
The above is my background with Shure.
This product that I'm writing about, for my experience ( 2 different ones) is a big let down from shure,

I wish this review is read by...Mr.Shure.... and consider it a CONSTRUCTIVE CRITICISM rather then a bitching complain from an unhappy buyer.
Back to the product,
received it charged full, patiently waiting overnight, pair it to my galaxy 9 ( I have uncompressed music as well on it using poweramp and a 400 card) and.... let the music start,
location of phone
in my carpenter pants pocket,
wireless dingy less than 2 feet away from phone, the sound was cutting off so frequently that I couldn't even make it through one song.
Called Shure, and as usual they answer pretty much right the way, and (with professionalism and curtest by the way) for whatever is worth they are in the US and they don't have an accent (I HAVE AN ACCENT MYSELF, a thick Italian one and so you put it in prospective, 2 accents from different countries speaking a third language.... it is not pretty, believe me therefor thank you guys and girls of shure to have to scramble me through the years)
they determined that, after trying to reset the device, I received a defective one,
no big deal, return it to amazon, received a replacement within 24 hours, charge it (yes I was impatient by this time around)
and astonishes hat I was the same problem occurred.
I have to be fair in saying that, this time around with the second device I could make it through 3 songs and the cutting was not as constant as the first time but still not a satisfactory situation, the signal keeps cutting off,
I tried the reset again (and the usul bluetooth reset bla bla bla) but no changes, the signal keeps cutting off.
In addition to the cutting off of the signal, the volume level is quite a bit muffled down and doesn't reach the level of sound that I would like to have.
Perhaps if the signal cutting off was not an issue I'm predicting that this volume decrease to be an issue as well.
At this point in time I just sent them back to Amazon with no further hesitation.

Please SHURE, listen to a faithful customer ( in my dreams I am working towards the 800... series one),
consider this an open letter to your engineering dept ( I will email a copy of this ranting to them as well as soon as I get the correct person email)
and keep your customers happy with the quality that kept us with you for all these years,
sincerely
Stefano
